title: verify/store.rs: empty identity string and None are conflated on round-trip
description: store.rs record_verifications (line 51) stores identity as identity.unwrap_or(""), mapping None to the empty string. get_verifications (line 83) converts empty string back to None. This conflates two distinct states: (a) identity was not known, and (b) identity was known to be the empty string. For DKIM results where mail-auth returns an empty domain (e.g. a malformed signature with d= tag missing), the identity is lost on read. Callers that query get_verifications and need to distinguish 'no identity' from 'empty identity' cannot do so. Fix: use a sentinel that cannot appear in a valid domain or pubkey hex (e.g. store NULL for None, and allow the identity column to be NULL).
